Longest Palindrome.title: Longest Palindrome
Longest Palindrome.description: Given a string s which consists of lowercase or uppercase letters, return the length of the longest palindrome that can be built with those letters. Letters are case-sensitive, e.g., "Aa" is not considered a palindrome.

Add Two Numbers.title: Add Two Numbers
Add Two Numbers.description: You are given two non-empty linked lists representing two non-negative integers. The digits are stored in reverse order, and each node contains a single digit. Add the two numbers and return the sum as a linked list.

Unique Paths.title: Unique Paths
Unique Paths.description: There is a robot on an m x n grid. The robot tries to reach the bottom-right corner and can only move down or right. How many possible unique paths are there?

Daily Temperatures.title: Daily Temperatures
Daily Temperatures.description: Given an array of integers temperatures, return an array answer such that answer[i] is the number of days you have to wait after the ith day to get a warmer temperature.

outputFormat.description: Days to wait for warmer temperature

Top K Frequent Elements.title: Top K Frequent Elements
Top K Frequent Elements.description: Given an integer array nums and an integer k, return the k most frequent elements. You may return the answer in any order.
constraints: Should be better than O(n log n)

Non-overlapping Intervals.title: Non-overlapping Intervals
Non-overlapping Intervals.description: Given an array of intervals intervals where intervals[i] = [start_i, end_i], return the minimum number of intervals you need to remove to make the rest of the intervals non-overlapping.

Search Insert Position.title: Search Insert Position
Search Insert Position.description: Given a sorted array of distinct integers and a target value, return the index if the target is found. If not, return the index where it would be if it were inserted in order.

Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array.title: Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array
Find Minimum in Rotated Sorted Array.description: Suppose an array of length n sorted in ascending order is rotated between 1 and n times. Given the possibly rotated array nums, return the minimum element. Use O(log n) time.

Happy Number.title: Happy Number
Happy Number.description: Write an algorithm to determine if a number n is happy. Replace by sum of squares of digits.
constraints: Detect cycles with set or Floyd

Palindrome Linked List.title: Palindrome Linked List
Palindrome Linked List.description: Given the head of a singly linked list, return true if it is a palindrome.

K Closest Points to Origin.title: K Closest Points to Origin
K Closest Points to Origin.description: Given an array of points, return the k closest points to the origin.

Pow(x, n).title: Pow(x, n)
Pow(x, n).description: Implement pow(x, n), which calculates x raised to the power n using fast exponentiation.

Merge K Sorted Lists.title: Merge K Sorted Lists
Merge K Sorted Lists.description:
You are given an array of k linked-lists lists, each linked-list is sorted in ascending order.

Merge all the linked-lists into one sorted linked-list and return it.
